name: Deformable Radial Kernel (DRK) Parametrization
definition: DRK attributes are modeled using unconstrained learnable parameters in (-∞, ∞), with activation functions to ensure valid ranges for opacity, scale, rotation, sharpness, blending weight, and basis angles.
summary: Deformable Radial Kernel Parametrization defines valid 3D Gaussian attributes via specialized activation functions, distinguishing itself with a three-step basis angle process for monotonicity and configurable density thresholds.
